contact.basis: Dry river-facing path beyond the surviving entrance, independently sampled from GSI elevation tiles.

verticalDatum: Official GSI elevation-tile heights; host-relative visualization. No local survey datum transformation or accuracy claim.

sourceSelection.method: First layer with all four valid interpolation pixels. NoData is never interpreted as zero or filled across gaps.

attribution: 国土地理院 地理院タイル (Geospatial Information Authority of Japan)
method: Original official RGB24 signed-centimetre tiles bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in the signed model frame. Bounded64m land-side grid retains independent heights without flattening or fitting the building. Original source tile bytes are retained.
limitations: Tile pixel spacing and centimetre encoding are not survey accuracy. GSI tiles are interpolated elevation products.
Grid bounds include the building and dry approaches, not the Motoyasu river bed or distant context. Other host terrain remains host-dependent.
